test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 08 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What was the theme of the ‘World Sustainable Development Summit’ organised by ‘The Energy and Resources Institute' (TERI) at India Habitat Centre New Delhi in March 2025?

options.text: Land Restoration, Desertification and Drought Resilience
Partnerships for Accelerating Sustainable Development and Climate Solutions

solution:
The correct answer is __**Partnerships for Accelerating Sustainable Development and Climate Solutions**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 'World Sustainable Development Summit' (WSDS) is an annual flagship event organized by **The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI)** to address climate change and sustainable development challenges worldwide.
 
• The theme for the March 2025 summit was **"Partnerships for Accelerating Sustainable Development and Climate Solutions."**
 
• This theme emphasized the importance of collaborative efforts across governments, private sectors, and civil societies to achieve global sustainable development goals (SDGs).
 
• The summit aimed to foster dialogue among policymakers, researchers, and businesses to accelerate climate action and promote sustainable economic growth.
 
• Key topics discussed during the summit included renewable energy, climate resilience, biodiversity conservation, and sustainable business practices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Land Restoration, Desertification, and Drought Resilience**

 
 
• This theme is related to combating land degradation and desertification, as well as enhancing resilience against droughts.
 
• The United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD) often focuses on these issues, aligning with SDG Goal 15 (Life on Land).
 
 
 
• **Invest In Our Planet**
 
 
• This theme is prominently associated with Earth Day celebrations, encouraging individuals, governments, and organizations to invest in actions that protect the planet.
 
• It promotes sustainable investments in clean energy, waste management, and circular economies.
 
 
 
• **Ecosystem Restoration**
 
 
• Ecosystem restoration is a global initiative aimed at reversing damage to ecosystems and restoring biodiversity.
 
• It is aligned with the UN Decade on Ecosystem Restoration (2021–2030) and is critical for achieving multiple SDGs.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **WSDS**

 
 
• WSDS has been held annually since 2001, serving as a global platform to deliberate on actionable solutions for sustainable development.
 
• The summit brings together global leaders, scientists, activists, and policymakers to address pressing environmental challenges.
 
• It highlights India's leadership in promoting sustainable development and climate action on the global stage.
